argv: Export times out on large projects

runs.answer:
Created APP-130, "Export times out on large projects", in project APP with Severity set to Show-stopper: https://acme.youtrack.cloud/issue/APP-130

Show-stopper is the highest value in the APP project's Severity field. The order from `ytrack project fields APP` is Cosmetic, Minor, Normal, Major, Show-stopper, so I took the last one as the highest.
